name: Send Help Menu
func:
msg.payload = {
    type: 'message',
    chatId: msg.payload.chatId,
    content: "ESP32 Fleet Commands

Usage: /[command] [machineName]

Example:
/status Machine1 — DI/DO states
/metrics Machine1 — Runtime, downtime, rejects
/health Machine1 — Temp, heap, WiFi, uptime, version no.
/do on 1 Machine1 — Turn DO 1 ON
/do off 1 Machine1 — Turn DO 1 OFF
/resetmetrics Machine1 — Reset all counters
/help — Show this menu"
};
return msg;
